# Test fixtures

Everything under `documents/` is synthetic: fabricated for tests, never a
real patient record. Each file declares that on its first comment line
(which unitizes as an ordinary unit).

The fixtures exercise schema-v3 unitization: numbered units across files
and form-feed pages, boilerplate suppression (URL-only lines, page counters,
repeated portal headers), `01_source.txt`, and the protected-content
candidate scan. `synthetic-er-visit.txt` is the end-to-end ER case whose
target report is in the PRD.

Model-authored write and verify artifacts are generated by the
deterministic test harness so no fixture can preserve a direct-summary
or fail-open publication route.

If de-identified real documents are later approved, add them alongside the
synthetic set without relabeling fabricated content or removing these files.
